UC-520.en: The browser saved {file} in Clauseo's own folder for this matter, not in the matter's folder: the matter's drive can't mark downloads as coming from the internet.
UC-520.hi: ब्राउज़र ने {file} को इस मामले के लिए Clauseo के अपने फ़ोल्डर में सहेजा है, मामले के फ़ोल्डर में नहीं: मामले की ड्राइव डाउनलोड को इंटरनेट से आया हुआ चिह्नित नहीं कर सकती।
UC-520.hi_by: guarddl notice (provisional; Hindi-speaking lawyer to review)
UC-520.note: Host notice NoticeKind::DownloadOutsideMatter (crates/host/src/sources/browser/fallback.rs): the browser saved a download in Clauseo's own folder for the matter (<app data>/agent-state/<matter>/downloads) because the matter's drive cannot keep the downloaded-from-the-internet mark. {file} is the file's plain name, isolated. The row ends with the existing Show in Finder / Show in File Explorer / Show in folder button, which reveals the file selected (reveal's download target)
